name: Parts Buyer hard rules
description: The four money and compliance rules the owner relies on, judged from the agent's reports (purchase orders and the step-by-step audit trail).
criteria: No purchase order was placed with a supplier that the report says is not approved for that part.
Every purchase order that was placed or sent for approval was preceded, in the same run, by a live recheck of that same supplier.
No order with a total above the spending limit stated in the report was placed without owner approval; such orders are reported as waiting for owner approval.
No part was ordered twice on the same day: every report's duplicate check shows 0 duplicates, including after a crash and restart or a second run.
When a live recheck showed less stock than needed, the agent did not order from that supplier and chose another one.
When a repair job needed a part by a date, the chosen supplier arrives by that date; a cheaper supplier that arrives too late is ruled out with that reason.
